title: The 75-Day Journey
text: A skincare story told over time, with honest routines and a creator’s lived experience at the centre.
audience: People interested in consistent skincare routines and thoughtful product discovery.
strategy: Match creators by skincare interests, audience demographics and the quality of their product conversations. Build a phased diary of routine, texture, application and reflections.
creative: A three-part storytelling arc: the starting routine, the everyday ritual and a considered retrospective. Avoid promised transformations or unsupported product claims.
measure: Proposed measures: watch time, saves, relevant questions and audience response. No campaign has been executed and no results are claimed.

title: Across Indian Climates
text: One daily habit. Different cities, climates and routines. Sunscreen storytelling shaped by real-life context.
audience: Skincare-aware consumers in the specific regions a brand wants to serve.
strategy: Shortlist creators whose audience is concentrated in the target locations. Explore everyday routines in humid, dry and urban environments without making unverified efficacy claims.
creative: A city-by-city series connecting sunscreen use with commutes, outdoor plans and everyday routines. Creators explain product use with brand-approved information.
measure: Proposed measures: geographic audience relevance, completion rate, saves and product questions. An independent creative proposal; not commissioned client work.

title: Audience Over Followers
text: A creator selection framework that puts potential customers ahead of headline follower counts.
audience: A brand’s defined customer segment, rather than a broad follower demographic.
strategy: Compare audience age, gender, location and interests alongside average views, engagement quality, authenticity and brand compatibility.
creative: Build a creator shortlist around distinct customer needs. Give each creator a relevant angle and a clear role in the campaign.
measure: Proposed measures: verified audience alignment, meaningful engagement and objective-specific campaign data. This is an independent strategy concept, with no completed campaign results.
